🎥🎬: Dolly Parton — A Life in Music & Legacy

Dolly Parton rose from poverty in the Smoky Mountains of Tennessee to become one of country music’s greatest legends. Through songs like Jolene, 9 to 5, and I Will Always Love You, she built a career spanning music, film, television, business, and songwriting, while becoming known just as much for her warmth and generosity as her talent. 

Beyond the stage, Dolly dedicated much of her success to helping others, most notably through her Imagination Library, which has provided hundreds of millions of free books to children. After six decades of entertaining generations, Dolly died at 80 on August 25, 2026, following a brief battle with cancer, leaving behind a legacy that reaches far beyond her music.
